The array element is typed by an ApplicationPrimitiveDataType of category BOOLEAN. On the right-hand side the implementation of the three-dimensional array is described with an ImplementationDataType which contains three nested ImplementationDataTypeElements. Matching ApplicationArrayElements and ImplementationDataTypeElements are shown on the same layer. For the sake of clarity correlating maxNumberOfElements and arraySize attributes are described with the identical instance of a SwSystemconst instead of a value.
